answers.core: Games with hexagonal tiles are pretty popular nowadays, and more 3D assets have hexagonal tiles now than before. Hexagonal tiles give a pretty aesthetic to a 3D game, and it makes sense for a general-purpose game engine to have hexagonal tile support OOTB.
answers.workaround: Nope. Not that I can think of, other than having very tiny cells for precise hexagonal placement, which is going to leave the error margin very low and can result in severe deterioration of player experience. The problem with such small cell size is that you need to be very very precise when placing tiles, which is very exhausting and time consuming.
